name: OpenAPI Search MCP Server
description: Enables AI assistants to load, parse, and query OpenAPI/Swagger documentation from URLs with intelligent search across endpoints, schemas, and authentication methods. Provides 10 specialized tools for comprehensive API exploration including path details, operation lookups, and multi-criteria search capabilities.
